From employer conversations to sponsored learners

Start with relevant commercial teams and a learning-and-development budget owner. Validate the business problem, staff preparation, time availability and funding before counting a company as a buyer. The size and posting signals above guide prospect research; they do not establish demand.

These are illustrative planning cases, not forecasts or commitments. A starter is one learner beginning the certificate, not four course registrations. Program approval, admissions, delivery format and pricing remain pending; the capacity test requires separate staffing validation.

Adjust the sponsorship assumptions





Working case: 4 sponsoring employers × 8 seats = 32 certificate starters. Tuition is unspecified.

Expected sponsors = accounts × conversion rate. Expected starters = sponsors × seats. Fractional results represent expected values, not enrollable people. Tuition receipts = starters × assumed net certificate tuition. Receipts exclude attrition, payment timing and refunds; they are not profit or NPV. Costs for development, teaching, advising, marketing and delivery still need a BU-approved model.

First employers to validate: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (7), IQVIA (6), AstraZeneca (4), Sanofi (2). Parentheses show local commercial-fit posting identities, not prospective enrollments. This ranking measures observed relevance in a selected dataset; collection coverage differs across employers.

Only 8 of the 20 shortlisted employer names are represented in the US inventory. Missing companies remain prospect-research opportunities, not evidence of no demand.

Local source-reported posting dates range from 2026-04-30 to 2026-10-23; 444 local records lack a source posting date. Database-created dates remain collection proxies. All dates, including old records, are included; these counts cannot measure current openings or annual hiring.

Geography and screening rules

Outreach area: Boston, Cambridge, Watertown, Waltham, Lexington, Burlington, Billerica, Bedford, Woburn, Somerville, Newton, Needham, Medford, Framingham, Natick, Marlborough, Andover. This is a declared sales territory, not the official Boston metropolitan statistical area. Worcester and other Massachusetts locations appear only in the statewide row.

State evidence uses the existing conservative parser: explicit Massachusetts or a comma-delimited MA abbreviation. City-only Cambridge, state-prefix strings such as “Ma Cambridge”, remote-only locations and conflicting multi-state locations stay outside local counts. Therefore these are conservative observed counts, not complete local hiring coverage.

Commercial fit is the subset of analytics-relevant records with commercial analytics titles, commercial-data duties, data products in business roles, or data products/datasets in analytical roles. It reuses the saved relevance reasons, without treating all clinical, scientific or operations analytics roles as certificate matches. Review individual duties before outreach.

The county map is an additional population-context layer. It neither allocates pharma postings to counties nor estimates the number of eligible learners. Historical county codes without a matching 2025 boundary are excluded rather than reassigned.
